name: BXH TokenStakingPoolDelegate pays USDT bonus at the live BXH/USDT spot quote
summary: TokenStakingPoolDelegate converts a staker's pending BXH reward into the pool's USDT bonus token with getITokenBonusAmount, which applies the constant-product formula to the BXH/USDT pair's live getReserves and pays the result from the contract's USDT balance. The attacker flash-borrowed 3.18M USDT, bought BXH to inflate the pair's USDT per BXH, then harvested about 15 BXH of pending reward from a prior vUSDT stake as 40,085.62 USDT, draining the bonus balance.

loss.notes: Net USDT depletion of the staking contract in the anchor: 40,085.623577085020521681 USDT paid out minus the 200 USDT the attack contract sent in first so the balance covered the payout. USDT (BSC-peg) valued at par. The honest value of the harvested reward at the pre-attack reserve ratio was about 2.6 USDT and is not deducted. The PancakeSwap flash-loan fee and the round-trip swap cost are attacker costs and are not netted.

ageReset.description: Admin Safe 0x445b0ad0c36fc0f0f3f51821d21a63701c821426 called add() creating pool 0 (vUSDT) with enableBonus=true, bonusToken USDT and swapPairAddress set to the BXH/USDT pair 0x919964b7f12a742e3d33176d7af9094ea4152e6f (PoolAdded log 205). Without an enabled bonus pool the spot-quote conversion path is unreachable.

sources.note: Loss. Receipt of source-1 (block 21727290, index 207, status 1; sender 0x81c63d821b7cdf70c61009a81fef8db5949ac0c9 -> attack contract 0x4e77df7b9cdcecec4115e59546f3eacba095a89f), USDT 0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955 Transfer logs: 492 flash swap of 3,178,800 USDT from WBNB/USDT pair 0x16b9a82891338f9ba80e2d6970fdda79d1eb0dae; 493 3,148,800 USDT into BXH/USDT pair 0x919964b7f12a742e3d33176d7af9094ea4152e6f for 148,851.122554820748325386 BXH (log 495); 498 attack contract -> staking contract 200 USDT; 499 staking contract -> attack contract 40085.623577085020521681 USDT; 501/503 BXH sold back for 3,148,687.356983872254615094 USDT; 506 repayment 3,186,778.788 USDT. eth_call USDT.balanceOf(0x27539b1dee647b38e1b987c41c5336b1a8dce663) is 40030.764994324038311630 at block 21727289 and 145.141417239017789949 at block 21727290 (no other staking-contract USDT transfer in the block per Etherscan tokentx). Net depletion 39885.623577085020521681 USDT.

Root cause, anchor and age. Verified TokenStakingPoolDelegate source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, chainid 56; v0.8.7+commit.e28d00a7, optimizer 200; SHA-256 of SourceCode be146fa21417d912be17a8dd7adbc1bb9e16ab20aca507c223b630552ac79917): depositIToken/withdrawIToken/depositITokenByDelegate, when pool.enableBonus, replace the pending BXH amount with getITokenBonusAmount(pid, pending), which reads IUniswapV2Pair(pool.swapPairAddress).getReserves() and returns a zero-fee constant-product amountOut, then safeBonusTransfer sends that much bonusToken. In source-1 the attack contract calls deposit(0, 0) (Deposit log 500) between the BXH buy and sell; eth_call pending(0, 0x4e77df7b9cdcecec4115e59546f3eacba095a89f) at block 21727289 is 15.239873538264498637 BXH on a 5582.890525516834000011 vUSDT stake, and BXH/USDT reserves at block 21727289 are 25147.47 USDT (token0) / 150042.58 BXH, so the unmanipulated value was about 2.55 USDT. Earliest exercise: Etherscan V2 tokentx (USDT, staking contract, blocks 0..21800000) has 447 transfers; the 8 transaction hashes absent from the contract's own txlist (752 transactions) are 6 inbound USDT funding transfers, one 2.9368 USDT delegate-routed harvest 0x9ef93913f200f72fc6fb749aaab677fdf276af293ce98a02367ad71ff0487239 (via 0x7d909f43af86d15253e2429302c9f1318370c45a, no pair swap in its logs) and source-1. All other harvests are single top-level EOA calls that cannot move the pair within the transaction. Age: eth_getCode empty at block 21542940; keccak256 of runtime 0xa9194c3f4943187ffd54565c7d60f7c76afc00217cb5c55144db4d53979d43b6 at blocks 21542941 and 21727289; source-2 is a top-level creation (to null) by 0xa81d30d483714438bd7ddd52b6033d65c6f0020c at index 67; no proxy, delegatecall target or selfdestruct path. Storage layout: Ownable _owner slot 0, ReentrancyGuard slot 1, userDepositInfo slot 2, iToken 3, tokenPerBlock 4, poolInfo slot 5 with 10-slot PoolInfo; poolInfo[0] base keccak256(5) = 0x036b6384b5eca791c62761152d0c79bb0604c104a5fb6f4eb0703f3154bb3db0. eth_getStorageAt at blocks 21543520/21543521/21727288: base+0 (lpToken) 0 -> vUSDT 0x19195ac5f36f8c75da129afca8f92009e292b84a; base+6 (enableBonus|bonusToken) 0 -> 0x...55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b319795501; base+7 (swapPairAddress) 0 -> 0x919964b7..., all unchanged at 21727288. Source-3 is admin Safe execTransaction (0x6a761202) by 0xd3f147f3860c58c72315aa4f964318d25944d05f; adminAddress() is the Safe. PoolAdded (topic 0x65e9a85cbd75f2b408db1d4a29b449bcb1b14cc4dd995b9499e6c10e9fbaf469) logs show pools 0..7 added in blocks 21543521..21557160; PoolBonusChanged (topic 0xb1983018fe052f5b126125eb67122851f80f389ccc9de41a6a67f3ffd8f1f139) first appears at block 21744073, after the exploit, repointing every pool's pair to 0x37dddef2301f9782b006a1739b5672c4ebf78734. Other pre-exploit admin calls (set allocPoint x25, setPoolDepositLimited x8, setDelegate, transferOwnership) do not touch the bonus path. The pool-0 creation is the latest change establishing the exploited state, so it supplies the age.
